population_limit: Conditional sample after prior registrations, development pages, and correction decisions; not an unbiased corpus-wide accuracy sample.
purpose: V3 metadata-only blind registration; all V1/V2 cases and correction-ledger decisions remain development evidence and are excluded.
selection_basis: Fixed SHA256 ordering over citation/page identity after excluding every V1/V2 registered headword, page, and source continuation plus correction-ledger decisions; accept one case per printed page and normalized headword until 24. No mining output or labels are read.
